evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general? (asked after substantial probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Monica raised doorway/wall protection concern; Nicole acknowledged with reassurance ('we will be putting some pads on your walls') but did not ask follow-up to understand depth; Monica then raised additional concern about rugs but Nicole moved forward without deepening either
evidence_quotes.value_days: No mention of Thursday October 15th being cheaper or more expensive than other days; no flexibility offered
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rate lock mentioned ('no deposit required if you have to reschedule or cancel no fees') but then immediately asked 'would you like our help with your move?' without clear separation; no formal rate lock statement; customer did not book on call, only asked to discuss with husband

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details early and naturally, covering addresses, property type, garage items, special pieces, rugs, bed details, and box counts without feeling checklist-driven.
coaching_note: Step 2 two-concerns question came after probing was already underway and Nicole did not dig two layers deep on either concern raised (doorway protection or rug movement); additionally, no final concerns check at step 6 and no genuine effort to close the estimate with the prep/temperature check before asking for the business.
